parsed_json.sql: SELECT m.chembl_id, m.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, di.efo_id AS indication_curie, COALESCE(di.efo_term, di.mesh_heading) AS indication_label, di.max_phase_for_ind FROM molecule_dictionary m JOIN drug_indication di ON m.molregno = di.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON m.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE di.max_phase_for_ind = 4 AND (di.mesh_heading LIKE '%multiple myeloma%' OR di.efo_term LIKE '%multiple myeloma%') ORDER BY m.chembl_id, m.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, di.max_phase_for_ind
